verdict.rationale: Whether a work-management SaaS publishes its source under an open license is a fair openness question, so the axis applies. The evidence only shows a public GitHub repo containing Asana's OpenAPI API specifications and a list of official client libraries, with no license stated. That is adjacent developer material, not the product's own source under an open license.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
